noah (Docs): FYI i pulled together a small follow-up for the Optimize toolkit PR. we shipped a streaming example but it uses the old helper and forgets to mention backpressure & prefetch guidance for short-prefix workloads. can we quick-check?
anya (DevEx): drop the snippets here. i can run them in the sample app.
noah (Docs): here's what landed 
```go
// current Go example in PR (uses streaming.oldStream)
stream := client.Streaming().oldStream(ctx, model, prompt)
for chunk := range stream.Chunks() {
  fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
}
```
and the YAML config we added for the quant profile:
```yaml
quant_profile: q8_0
notes: "recommended for cost but may degrade long-form generation"
```
omar (Runtime): oldStream is gone in the runtime v2 SDK. use client.stream.open or client.batch.stream with a context that supports cancel for backpressure. also for short repeated prefixes we recommend calling cache.prefetch(prefixes, {mode: "kv"}) before sending requests to save repeated KV recompute.
tess (ML): add a short sentence about quant profiles: q4_0 tends to preserve generation quality better than q8_0 for some instruction-following tasks; q8_0 can be fine for embeddings but run a small eval harness first. put a link to the quant eval notebook.
anya (DevEx): thanks. i'll update the Go snippet to:
```go
stream := client.stream.open(ctx, model, opts.WithMaxTokens(256))
for chunk := range stream.Recv() {
  if ctx.Err() != nil { break } // backpressure/cancel
  fmt.Print(chunk.GetText())
}
```
plus a one-line prefetch example snippet:
```py
# python prefetch example
client.cache.prefetch(["user_prompt_v1"], mode="kv")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/fast-ggml", prompt=prompt)
```
ci-bot: docs-lint: found a broken link in PR #612 -> /docs/sdk/go/streaming (404) :warning:
noah (Docs): i'll fix the link target and add a changelog note about SDK v2 runtime changes (stream API + cache.prefetch). also adding a small migration checklist entry: "search for .oldStream and batch.create usages".
omar (Runtime): FYI leave a short note in the Optimize page about sequence-length distributions (short vs long) since batching behavior changes. a small table is fine.
tess (ML): i pushed a tiny eval snippet and a one-liner about q4_0 vs q8_0 tradeoffs into the PR comments.
noah (Docs): great. i updated the PR (now #612) with the Go replacement, python prefetch snippet, quant note, and fixed links. tagging @engineering for a quick sign-off. :white_check_mark: closing this thread after merge.
